newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Imaging acquires Sun MRI.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Imaging acquires Sun MRI.

text.p: Alliance Imaging Inc said Tuesday it has acquired Sun MRI Services Inc, a move that will add six new hospitals to Alliance's's customer base, boost annual revenue by $1.2 million and accrete to earnings.
Terms of the all-cash transaction were undisclosed.

Sun MRI provides magnetic resonance imaging services in northern California. Alliance is a leading provider of hospital-based fixed-site and mobile magnetic resonance imaging and computed tomography services.
The Sun purchase represents the company's fourth acquisition in the past year.
